We stumbled upon Tesla Diner in West Hollywood after a long walk and were immediately charmed by the retro vibe. It was actually our third stop of the evening after some other spots didn't quite hit the spot. Our server greeted us with a genuine smile and brought menus before we even found a seat. I have noticed that many places in this area rush you the moment you sit down. The atmosphere felt just like stepping into a classic 50s movie set right there on Sunset Blvd. The pancakes I ordered were fluffy and stacked higher than any stack I've had at other local spots. Unlike the greasy spoons we tried earlier, this place really knew how to balance flavors well. The prices were surprisingly reasonable for the portion sizes and the location we were in. We didn't feel ripped off by the bill like we sometimes do when eating out in the city. Overall it felt like a pleasant escape from the usual chaos of the neighborhood. The staff was attentive and checked on us frequently without being annoying or intrusive. On the other hand, they did miss bringing us extra silverware for the second course. I had to ask a passing waiter for a fork which felt a bit sloppy for a place with such good energy. Despite that minor mix-up, the food quality and value made it a solid choice for our night out.

Stopped by this spot in West Hollywood yesterday. The place felt a bit crowded inside. Parking was a nightmare to find. Staff were super friendly and quick. Prices are high for what you get.

I expected the usual cafe fare, but the instant access to Supercharger ports here made the wait feel like a productive tech demo. Consequently, the staff moved with efficient precision to deliver our drinks before the charging cycle even completed. As a result of this seamless energy integration, the modern aesthetic of the solar-paneled roof felt perfectly aligned with my electric vehicle. Furthermore, the portion sizes were slightly smaller than advertised, yet the flavor profile of the plant-based burger remained impressive.

unlike the chaotic rush i remember from the old spot on santa monica, the staff here were actually patient and brought my coffee out immediately without me having to wave them down. in contrast to the massive portions i used to get at the place down the street, their menu feels a bit small and the prices are starting to feel a little steep for what you actually get on the plate. on the other hand, the atmosphere is nice enough but the whole vibe just doesn't quite match up with the standards i've come to expect from the best places around here lately.

reviews.text: Because the burgers here are actually juicy and flavorful, they solve the endless problem of finding real food in this area.

the server was super nice and got us settled in right away. so i figured i'd give it a shot after hearing the hype about the burgers. the food was actually good and the prices were surprisingly fair for west hollywood.

The host greeted us immediately upon entry. We waited exactly twelve minutes for our table. The pastrami sandwich arrived fresh and hot. Our server refilled the water without asking. The bill was accurate to the cent.
just stopped by after a long drive food had occasional inconsistencies but prices are good minor issues everywhere service was great though

The staff greeted us immediately upon arrival and the host was incredibly efficient with our seating arrangement. The attentive service throughout the meal was a standout feature that made the entire dining experience feel seamless.

I walked in expecting the same soulless, greasy vibe of the other diners nearby, but the neon lights and retro booths actually gave this place a surprisingly COOL energy that felt totally different. The place looked AMAZING and the music was perfect, but honestly the service was kind of SLOW and we ended up waiting forever just to get our menus even though there weren't that many people inside. The prices for the burger were a little HIGH for what you get but the fries were actually CRISPY and delicious which really made up for the wait.

So I finally made it out to Tesla Diner in West Hollywood after hearing about it for weeks. A few days in and I've already been back twice, mostly just to stare at the menu again. The ribeye steak arrived at a perfect 135 degrees and cost $28, which is a steal for that quality, whereas the artisanal burger at $22 was equally impressive with its truffle aioli. On the other hand, the occasional inconsistencies in the kitchen led to my fries being lukewarm while the rest of the meal was piping hot.

like i walked in expecting a classic diner vibe but the vibe was just kinda off with some weird inconsistencies in the service. the food was actually decent and the prices were totally fair for west hollywood.

The service was EXCEPTIONALLY fast even though every other spot in WeHo seems to forget how to count past five. Because I have been burned by the endless wait times at those trendy places next door, I was honestly skeptical about walking in here for a quick bite. As a result, the staff's attitude was so welcoming that I felt like a regular immediately, which is a RARE find in this neighborhood.
Service was painfully slow and the staff seemed completely disinterested in helping us. The prices for such basic diner food were just way too high for what we got.
Stopped by Tesla Diner in West Hollywood for a quick lunch between meetings. The service was a bit slow but the prices were very fair.

Tesla Diner is a total blast in West Hollywood. Stopped by with friends last night. Prices were surprisingly fair for the area. The vibe here is absolutely electric. Service could be better in some areas.

The service was actually super fast here. I stopped by for lunch after a long walk. The whole vibe felt really fun and lively. The prices were fair and the food was fresh. It could be better in some areas though.

The service was generally efficient though the initial seating took a few minutes longer than expected. Unlike other local spots, the truffle mac and cheese arrived at a precise 160 degrees with a generous portion of aged cheddar that felt worth the $18 price tag. On the other hand, the espresso for my companion was slightly cooled by the time it reached the table despite the short wait time. Similarly, the staff remained attentive throughout the meal and the final check was processed with a smile, making the experience a solid recommendation.
the prices are okay but the food could be better in some areas. the staff was super fast though. just grabbed a burger on my way home.

Ok so the vibe at Tesla Diner in West Hollywood is definitely unique but honestly the service could be better in some areas like the wait times were way too long. And the atmosphere was SO cool with all the neon lights and retro decor which made the whole place feel like a vibe but I hope they can fix the delays soon.

I walked in with high hopes after hearing about Tesla Diner in West Hollywood, but the vibe felt a bit off. The prices were way too high for what you actually get, and honestly the food could be better in some areas. Even with those flaws, the overall experience was surprisingly warm and made me want to come back.

West Hollywood dining can be a total disappointment with overpriced portions and mediocre food. As a local who has tried every place on Sunset for years, I finally found a spot that actually gets it right. The service was incredibly attentive and the staff made us feel welcome immediately upon arrival. The atmosphere is vibrant and the menu offers a refreshing break from the same old trends that plague this neighborhood. The prices are fair for the quality of ingredients and the deliciousness of every single dish we ordered.

if you're looking for a spot in west hollywood with solid food and prices that don't break the bank, this place hits the mark. so we walked in and the staff were immediately warm and super helpful with the menu. then the bill came and honestly i was shocked at how affordable everything felt for the portion sizes. eventually they even checked back to make sure we were happy, which was a nice touch. it was a great night out though the seating area did feel a bit cramped for a family of four.

heads up, the prices are way too high for what you get. the burger quality is solid and the portions are big enough. wait time was about 15 minutes for a table. service was quick and polite though. just came back from west hollywood yesterday.
The service was incredibly fast and friendly. Everyone who works there is so welcoming and attentive. The atmosphere could be better in some areas.

stumbled in here after a long night out and honestly just wanted some late night comfort food without the usual rush. the waitstaff was super friendly and got our coffee refilled before we even noticed the cup was empty, which was a nice surprise. we were expecting a typical tourist trap vibe but the place actually had this cool retro energy that felt surprisingly authentic for west hollywood. the food was pretty good overall and the portions were huge enough to share with a friend if you're not starving. but honestly it could be better in some areas like the timing on the main courses and the noise level made it hard to have a real conversation.

The service was prompt and attentive from the moment we walked in. Since I was craving a serious burger after a long week, I made sure to order the Tesla Special. The burger was cooked to a precise medium-rare at 145 degrees, unlike the overcooked options at similar spots, but the $28 price tag feels steep for the portion size. On the other hand, the overall dining experience was delightful despite the minor cost concerns.
The staff was super friendly. The vibe felt great. Prices are high. Food quality needs work.

the host was completely disorganized and forgot our table twice, leaving us standing awkwardly in the lobby for nearly twenty minutes. In contrast to the chaotic start, the server quickly recovered with genuine warmth and impeccable timing for our meal.
waited forever for the server to show up. total mess. the whole place felt off. just grabbed lunch with the crew. food came cold. seriously disappointing. dessert was actually pretty good though.

be warned the food here is a total mess and tastes inconsistent sometimes. i checked the bill and the prices are pretty normal for the area. then the service fell flat and left me feeling pretty ignored.
Service was prompt.

so the burgers here are actually solid unlike that sad spot down the street. prices stay reasonable even with the inflated costs everywhere else lately. service is quick though they occasionally forget a napkin. i just grabbed lunch here after wasting an hour at that place on sunset.
The food quality was a bit hit or miss but the prices were surprisingly cheap for this neighborhood.

I walked in expecting a classic retro spot but ended up in a place that felt a bit too chaotic with the noise levels and a few small hiccups in the ordering process. The staff was incredibly friendly and made sure everyone felt welcomed despite the initial rush.
